message.content:
**Pantone Color Code:**  
*Pantone 14‑4318 TCX – “Sky Blue”*

This designation comes from Pantone’s **Color Bridge Guide**, which maps spot colors to their nearest CMYK equivalents. If you’re looking at a physical Pantone swatch book or using digital design software, look up “Sky Blue” under the *Tonal System* section—this is the standardized reference used across many industries.
